title: Asking
description: Ask the questions you need answered.
grammar: question words and the verb hacer
grammarNote: The question words carry accents in a question: qué, quién, dónde, cuándo, cómo, cuánto.

explanation.summary: There are seven question words, and each one asks for a different kind of answer. Spanish marks them with an accent, which is how you can tell a question from a statement.

sections.heading: The seven
sections.body: Qué asks for a thing: ¿Qué es esto? Quién asks for a person: ¿Quién es? Dónde asks for a place: ¿Dónde está? Cuándo asks for a time: ¿Cuándo llegas? Por qué asks for a reason: ¿Por qué no vienes? Cómo asks about a way: ¿Cómo se dice? Cuánto asks for a quantity: ¿Cuánto cuesta?

sections.heading: Which one
sections.body: Cuánto asks how much, and cuál asks which one: ¿Cuál prefieres, té o café? Use cuál when the choice is in front of you, and qué when it is open: ¿Qué quieres? The plural is cuáles: ¿Cuáles prefieres?

examples.en: Which one do you prefer, tea or coffee?

sections.heading: Making a question out of a statement
sections.body: Spanish does not use word order for questions. You take a statement and put the question word in front, and the accent does the rest: Tú eres estudiante becomes ¿Eres estudiante? There is no do, and the subject stays where it is.

examples.es: El café está frío. → ¿Está frío el café?
La reunión es a las tres. → ¿Es a las tres la reunión?

sections.heading: Hacer, to make and to do
sections.body: Hacer is the verb for making and for doing. In the question how do you say it, you use the word for what you are saying, not hacer: ¿Cómo se dice hello? It also means to make a phone call: llamar, and it appears in the expression qué haces, what are you doing.

examples.en: How do you say thank you?

items.note: What. It carries an accent in a question.
Who. It carries an accent in a question.
Where. It carries an accent in a question.
When. It carries an accent in a question.
Why. Por and qué are written separately.
How. It carries an accent in a question.
How much or how many. It carries an accent in a question.
Its forms are irregular: hago, haces, hace.
Feminine: la ayuda. You ask for it with pedir ayuda.

drills.note: How do you say it uses cómo se dice.
Por qué asks for a reason.
